patterns.note: The homepage features a full-bleed hero image followed by a vertically stacked grid of project showcases, each with an image and descriptive text.
Main headings and project titles use an extremely large, wide-letter-spaced, uppercase sans-serif typeface, creating a monumental and impactful visual statement.
A consistent palette of deep, earthy browns and near-blacks for backgrounds provides a strong contrast to crisp white text and warm, muted orange/gold accent colors used for labels and links.

As the user scrolls, content sections and project showcases reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation, while the main navigation (GOA logo and menu) sticks to the top right, and a 'BACK TO TOP' element appears on the right edge.
Project showcases consistently pair a large, high-quality image with a concise title and a small, colored category label (e.g., 'BUILD', 'METROPOLIS').

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero image with large, impactful overlay typography sets the initial tone, with the image scrolling out of view to reveal content below.
A sticky navigation element remains visible in the top right corner after initial scroll, providing persistent access to the menu and site identity.
Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation, where elements subtly fade in or slide into place as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic browsing experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, wide-set, uppercase sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text size) create a monumental feel, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more balanced grid for project showcases.

standout: The site's distinctive use of monumental, wide-set uppercase typography for all major headings, combined with a rich, earthy color palette and natural imagery, creates a powerful and sophisticated architectural brand identity that feels both modern and deeply rooted.
